notes: Accessed via headed Playwright/Chromium (direct HTTP curl and headless Chromium were both blocked by Akamai bot-manager 'Access Denied' / 403; headed Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled passed the challenge, satisfying access-tier 2). robots.txt (www.zarahome.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: (1) the ES category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-es-0.xml.gz, 1670 category URLs) for navidad/christmas, halloween, reyes/reyes-magos, san-valentin/valentine, pascua/easter, ano-nuevo/new-year, diwali, festivo/festival, adviento, arbol/regalo-navidad slugs; (2) the site's own embedded nav-menu JSON (present in every rendered page's DOM, live as of 2026-09-03) for the same keyword set case-insensitively. Result: zero live Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Valentine/Easter/New Year/Festive category PLPs found -- only 'navidad-editorial-2-n4588', which renders as an old editorial/culinary-stories page (title 'CULINARY STORIES WITH IMOGEN KWOK AND THIERRY BOUTEMY'), not a product listing, so excluded per NEVER-EXTRACT editorial rule. The only genuine live seasonal branch is 'Vuelta al cole' (Back to School), confirmed via the site's own nav aria-labels ('Ver todo' and 'Decoracion y juguetes' both nested under the Vuelta al cole menu section, alongside an excluded 'EDITORIAL' link at vuelta-al-cole-editorial-n5395). A third candidate URL from the sitemap, ninos-vuelta-al-cole-coleccion-n5406, now redirects to error.html (dead link) and was excluded. Zara Home ES shows no numeric product-count display on any category page (no 'Showing X of Y' text and no matching count field in rendered HTML); qty for both rows was established by full enumeration -- scrolling and clicking any 'ver mas' control until the on-page product count stabilized for >=4 consecutive rounds, cross-checked against the initial SSR-rendered count. Kids Back to School (n5037, 48 items) and Back to School Decoration & Toys (n5041, 24 items) partially overlap (8 of 24 decor items also appear in the broader kids listing) but are not identical listings -- n5037 also carries school supplies/furniture/stationery beyond n5041's decor+toys subset -- so both are kept as genuine sibling category rows rather than deduplicated. This is likely a seasonal gap in coverage rather than a permanent absence: Christmas/Halloween sections plausibly launch closer to those dates; this snapshot reflects 2026-09-03.
